messages:
sam: NebulaGrid approached us for a co-marketing push: marketplace listing + benchmark mini-post + 30-min webinar. Can we do a tight 4-week cadence? Need owners and minimal routing rules.

raj: I can run the marketplace listing and get asset approvals. Ask them for logo pack and a short partner blurb.

meera: I9ll draft the mini-benchmark and short methodology. Recommend we surface: 5k context p95, tokens/sec, and a 1-line cost delta vs baseline. Will run tests this week.

luke: I9ll own webinar ops and the registration page. Proposed slots: Tue Jul 21 or Thu Jul 23. Need speakers locked 7 business days prior.

claire: For inbound leads, I suggest partner_tag=nebulagrid and origin=marketplace_webinar. Route marketplace leads -> partner-ops queue for 48h qualification -> SDRs on conversion. SFDC mapping: Partner_Tag__c and Lead_Origin__c.

sam: Good. Keep routing simple for the first run so Partnerships can vet intros. Luke, add hidden partner_tag on the reg page.

meera: I9ll highlight any caveats (warmup, batch sizes) in the methodology. ETA for bench draft: Thu EOD.

raj: Sending NebulaGrid the co-brand checklist. Will tag you for review, Sam.

claire: Routing snippet for Eng/SFDC admin to implement (simple):
```json
{ "partner_tag": "nebulagrid", "origin": "marketplace_webinar", "route_to": "partner-ops", "qual_sla_hours": "48" }
```
Map Partner_Tag__c <- partner_tag; Lead_Origin__c <- origin; AssignmentRule -> partner-ops.

ops-bot: Reminder: request co-brand assets from NebulaGrid by 2026-07-10 09:00 PT.

sam: Owners recap:
- Marketplace listing & approvals: raj
- Mini-benchmark + fig: meera
- Webinar ops & reg page: luke
- Lead tagging & SFDC mapping: claire
- Launch social + short blog: sam

luke: NebulaGrid PM prefers Jul 21 morning PT. Locking webinar for 2026-07-21 9am PT. I9ll create the reg page and calendar invite.

sam: Great. Update the tracker with ETAs and any blocked items. If legal or assets lag, we escalate to Partnerships. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
